slides.texte_overlay:
7 social skills that'll make you
dangerously likeable in your 20s
Learn to be happy when friends win. A promotion, a new girlfriend, a trip you can't afford. Say "Proud of you, man" and mean it. Jealous guys get fewer invites. Generous ones get all of them.

Learn to keep in touch with no reason. "Saw this and thought of you." One message a week to someone you haven't talked to in a while. In ten years, that's the difference between a big circle and an empty one.
Learn to admit when you don't know something. "No idea, tell me." People love explaining things, and it makes you look secure, not stupid. Faking it is what actually makes you look clueless.
Learn to host the group chat plan. Pick a date, a place and a time, then send it. "Friday, 8pm, Luigi's. Who's in?" Most groups die because nobody decides. Be the one who does.
Learn a little about everything. Five minutes a day of history, art or science. It turns small talk into real conversation, and people love being around a guy who's curious about the world.
slides.texte_sophia: I started doing five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It turned small talk into real conversation, and people noticed fast.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to drop a grudge. Someone forgot your birthday or flaked on plans. Say it once, calmly, then move on. Guys who keep score end up with a scoreboard and no friends to show it to.
Learn to be on time, every time. Ten minutes early is on time. It tells people you respect them before you've said a word, and it's the cheapest way to become the friend everyone trusts.
